examples.text: yass'indriyāni samathaṅ'gatāni, assā yathā sārathinā sudantā, pahīnamānassa anāsavassa, devā'pi tassa pihayanti tādino.

59301.meaning1: sign of mental stillness; basis for calming

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, samathanimittaṃ abyagganimittaṃ. tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro, ayam'āhāro anuppannassa vā samādhisambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā samādhisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.

59302.meaning1: preceded by calm; with serenity first

examples.text: idha, āvuso, bhikkhu samathapubbaṅ'gamaṃ vipassanaṃ bhāveti. tassa samathapubbaṅ'gamaṃ vipassanaṃ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati. so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
kati saṅkhār'upekkhā vipassanāvasena uppajjanti? aṭṭha saṅkhār'upekkhā samathavasena uppajjanti. dasa saṅkhār'upekkhā vipassanāvasena uppajjanti.

59307.meaning1: calm and insight; stilling and seeing; calmly observing
59307.commentary: (SNa) ettha mahāyodho viya samatho, paṇḍitāmacco viya vipassanā veditabbā.

examples.text: sīghaṃ dūtayuga'nti kho, bhikkhu, samathavipassanān'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. nagarassāmī'ti kho, bhikkhu, viññāṇass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. majjhe siṅghāṭako'ti kho, bhikkhu, catunn'etaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ adhivacanaṃ
puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu samathavipassanaṃ yuganaddhaṃ bhāveti. tassa samathavipassanaṃ yuganaddhaṃ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati. so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.

59311.meaning1: supported by serenity of mind; assisted by calm

examples.text: idh'āvuso, sammādiṭṭhi sīl'ānuggahitā ca hoti, sut'ānuggahitā ca hoti, sākacch'ānuggahitā ca hoti, samath'ānuggahitā ca hoti, vipassan'ānuggahitā ca hoti.

59312.meaning1: with even teeth; twenty-fourth of the thirty-two marks of a great man
59312.commentary: (MNa) aññesañ'ca keci dantā uccā keci nīcā'ti visamā honti, tathāgatassa pana ayapaṭṭachinnasaṅkhapaṭalaṃ viya samā.

examples.text: samadanto kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

59313.meaning1: auspicious marks of having even teeth and extremely white canines
59313.construction:
samadanta + susukkadāṭhā + lakkhaṇa + āni
samadantasusukkadāṭhālakkhaṇa + āni

examples.text: sabbhi'r'eva samāsetha, paṇḍiteh'atthadassibhi, atthaṃ mahantaṃ gambhīraṃ, duddasaṃ nipuṇaṃ aṇuṃ, dhīrā samadhigacchanti, appamattā vicakkhaṇā'ti.

59318.commentary: (MNa) samadhigayha tiṭṭhatī'ti dibbasukhaṃ gaṇhitvā tato visiṭṭhatarā hutvā tiṭṭhati.

examples.text: yāh'ayaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, rati, aññatr'eva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehi, api dibbaṃ sukhaṃ samadhigayha tiṭṭhati, tāya ratiyā ramamāno hīnassa na pihemi, na tattha abhiramāmi.

59319.commentary: (SNa) samadhiggayhā'ti samadhiggaṇhitvā, ādiyitvā'ti attho. (ANa) samadhiggayhā'ti suṭṭhu gaṇhitvā. (SNt) samadhiggayhā'ti sammā ativiya gahetvā, ñāyena visesato gaṇhitvā.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, atthi nu kho, bhante, eko dhammo yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati, diṭṭhadhammikañ'c'eva atthaṃ samparāyikañ'cā'ti?

59320.meaning1: carrying the same weight; having equal value

59321.commentary: (SNa) samadhosī'ti samantato adhosi, calan'ākārena apacitiṃ dassesi. vattaṃ kir'etaṃ bāḷhagilānena'pi buḍḍhataraṃ disvā uṭṭhān'ākārena apaciti dassetabbā. tena pana mā cali mā calī'ti vattabbo. (ANa) samadhosī'ti uṭṭhān'ākāraṃ dassesi.

examples.text: disvāna mañcake samadhosi. atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ vakkaliṃ etadavoca, alaṃ, vakkali, mā tvaṃ mañcake samadhosi. santimāni āsanāni paññattāni, tatth'āhaṃ nisīdissāmī'ti.

59322.meaning1: with understanding; with intelligence; (comm) with mind
59322.construction:
sa + √man + as + ka
sa + manas + ka

examples.text: api c'āhaṃ, āvuso, imasmiṃ'y'eva byāmamatte kaḷebare sasaññimhi samanake lokañ'ca paññāpemi lokasamudayañ'ca lokanirodhañ'ca lokanirodhagāminiñ'ca paṭipadan'ti.
hetupaccayo, ārammaṇapaccayo, adhipatipaccayo, anantarapaccayo, samanantarapaccayo, sahajātapaccayo, aññam'aññapaccayo

59330.commentary: (VINa) upasampannasamanantarā'ti upasampanno hutvā samanantarā. (DNa) catutthajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā samanantarā bhagavā parinibbāyī'ti ettha jhānasamanantaraṃ, paccavekkhaṇāsamanantaran'ti dve samanantarāni. tattha jhānā vuṭṭhāya bhav'aṅgaṃ otiṇṇassa tatth'eva parinibbānaṃ jhānasamanantaraṃ nāma.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu upasampannasamanantarā anācāraṃ ācarati. bhikkhū evam'āhaṃsu, m'āvuso, evarūpaṃ akāsi, n'etaṃ kappatī'ti.

paṭhamajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji, dutiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji, tatiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji, catutthajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā samanantarā bhagavā parinibbāyi.

59333.commentary: (DNa) samanuyuñjantan'ti samanuyuñjantu, ettha ca laddhiṃ pucchanto samanuyuñjati nāma, kāraṇaṃ pucchanto samanugāhati nāma, ubhayaṃ pucchanto samanubhāsati nāma.

atha kho mayaṃ, bhante, ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetu'kāmā samanuyuñjimha samanugāhimha samanubhāsimha

examples.text: tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, yamo rājā paṭhamaṃ devadūtaṃ samanuyuñjitvā samanugāhitvā samanubhāsitvā dutiyaṃ devadūtaṃ samanuyuñjati samanugāhati samanubhāsati, ambho purisa, na tvaṃ addasa manussesu dutiyaṃ devadūtaṃ pātubhūtan'ti? so evam'āha, n'āddasaṃ, bhante'ti.

examples.text: tato aparena samayena samanuggāhīyamāno vā asamanuggāhīyamāno vā āpanno visuddh'āpekkho evaṃ vadeyya ajānam'evaṃ āvuso avacaṃ jānāmi, apassaṃ passāmi
tato aparena samayena samanuggāhīyamāno vā asamanuggāhīyamāno vā amūlakañ'c'eva taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ hoti, bhikkhu ca dosaṃ patiṭṭhāti, saṅgh'ādiseso.

evaṃ pariyāyadesite kho, ānanda, mayā dhamme ye aññam'aññassa subhāsitaṃ sulapitaṃ na samanujānissanti na samanumaññissanti na samanumodissanti tesam'etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivād'āpannā aññam'aññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharissanti.
attanā ca pāṇ'ātipātī hoti parañ'ca pāṇ'ātipāte samādapeti pāṇ'ātipāte ca samanuñño hoti
idam'avoca sā devatā. samanuñño satthā ahosi. atha kho sā devatā, samanuñño me satthā'ti bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth'ev'antaradhāyī'ti.
n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yena anuppanno vā kāmacchando uppajjati uppanno vā kāmacchando bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, subhanimittaṃ
so sabbehi imehi pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi visuddham'attānaṃ samanupassati, vimuttam'attānaṃ samanupassati.

59346.synonym: adhipajjati, avekkhati, dahati, dahāti, paccavekkhati, samekkhati

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yathā iṇaṃ yathā rogaṃ yathā bandhan'āgāraṃ yathā dāsabyaṃ yathā kantār'addhānamaggaṃ ime pañca nīvaraṇe appahīne attani samanupassati

59347.meaning1: mode of seeing; way of regarding things
59347.commentary: (SNa) dukkhasamudayagāminī samanupassanā'ti yasmā sakkāyo dukkhaṃ, tassa ca samudayagāminī paṭipadā nāma rūpaṃ attato samanupassatī'ti evaṃ diṭṭhisamanupassanā vuttā, tasmā dukkhasamudayagāminī samanupassanā'ti ayam'ettha attho hoti. (SNa) dukkhanirodhagāminī samanupassanā'ti ettha saha vipassanāya catumaggañāṇaṃ samanupassanā'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sakkāyasamudayagāminī paṭipadā, sakkāyasamudayagāminī paṭipadā'ti. iti h'idaṃ, bhikkhave, vuccati dukkhasamudayagāminī samanupassanā'ti. ayam'ev'ettha attho.
iti ayañ'c'eva samanupassanā asmī'ti c'assa avigataṃ hoti. asmī'ti kho pana, bhikkhave, avigate pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ avakkanti hoti

tassa sabbehi imehi pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi visuddham'attānaṃ samanupassato, vimuttam'attānaṃ samanupassato, pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
so evaṃ samanupassanto asati na paritassatī'ti.
na h'eva kho me vedanā attā, appaṭisaṃvedano me attā'ti iti vā hi, ānanda, attānaṃ samanupassamāno samanupassati.
ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā anekavihitaṃ attānaṃ samanupassamānā samanupassanti, sabb'ete pañc'upādānakkhandhe samanupassanti, etesaṃ vā aññataraṃ.

59352.meaning1: should be seen; should be considered (as)
59352.meaning2: should be seen; should be considered

59376.meaning1: being cross-questioned; being cross-examined (by someone about something)

examples.text: evam'pi kho ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo tehi bhikkhūhi samanuyuñjiyamāno samanugāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno tadeva pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ thāmasā parāmāsā abhinivissa voharati
evam'eva kho tvaṃ, aggivessana, mayā sakasmiṃ vāde samanuyuñjiyamāno samanugāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno ritto tuccho aparaddho.

59377.grammar: prp of pass of saṃ anu √yuj, pass, intrans (+instr & +loc)
59377.meaning1: being cross-questioned; being cross-examined (by someone about something)

examples.text: te hi nāma, assalāyana, satta brāhmaṇ'isayo asitena devalena isinā sake jātivāde samanuyuñjīyamānā samanuggāhīyamānā samanubhāsīyamānā na sampāyissanti, kiṃ pana tvaṃ eta'r'ahi mayā sakasmiṃ jātivāde samanuyuñjīyamāno samanuggāhīyamāno samanubhāsīyamāno sampāyissasi, yesaṃ tvaṃ sācariyako na puṇṇo dabbigāho'ti.

59379.meaning1: having thoroughly advised; having instructed well

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, rājā daḷhanemi jeṭṭhaputtaṃ kumāraṃ sādhukaṃ rajje samanusāsitvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbaji.

gāmo nāma ekakuṭiko'pi gāmo, dvikuṭiko'pi gāmo, tikuṭiko'pi gāmo, catukuṭiko'pi gāmo, samanusso'pi gāmo, amanusso'pi gāmo, parikkhitto'pi gāmo, aparikkhitto'pi gāmo, gonisādiniviṭṭho'pi gāmo, yo'pi sattho atirekacatumāsaniviṭṭho so'pi vuccati gāmo.

cakkhuviññeyyānaṃ rūpānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ manoramānaṃ lok'āmisapaṭisaṃyuttānaṃ paṭilābhaṃ vā paṭilābhato samanupassato pubbe vā paṭiladdhapubbaṃ atītaṃ niruddhaṃ vipariṇataṃ samanussarato uppajjati somanassaṃ.
evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, goṇo kiṭṭh'ādo gāmagato vā araññagato vā, ṭhānabahulo vā assa nisajjabahulo vā na taṃ kiṭṭhaṃ puna otareyya, tam'eva purimaṃ daṇḍasamphassaṃ samanussaranto.

59384.meaning2: having recollected, having called to mind

examples.text: vijambhitvā samantā catuddisā anuviloketi
ye kho pan'ānanda, samantā gāmā ahesuṃ, te ten'obhāsena kamm'ante payojesuṃ divā'ti maññamānā.

59387.meaning1: all seeing one; epithet of the Buddha
59387.commentary: (NIDD1) kathaṃ bhagavā samantacakkhunā'pi vivaṭacakkhu? samantacakkhu vuccati sabbaññutañāṇaṃ. bhagavā sabbaññutañāṇena upeto samupeto upagato samupagato upapanno samupapanno samannāgato. (SNPa) samantacakkhū'ti'pi bhagavantam'eva sabbaññutaññāṇena ālapati.

examples.text: eko ahaṃ sakka mahantam'oghaṃ, anissito no visahāmi tārituṃ, ārammaṇaṃ brūhi samantacakkhu, yaṃ nissito ogham'imaṃ tareyyaṃ.
passām'ahaṃ devamanussaloke, akiñcanaṃ brāhmaṇam'iriyamānaṃ, taṃ taṃ namassāmi samantacakkhu, pamuñca maṃ sakka kathaṃkathāhi.

59388.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of samanta
59388.meaning1: all around; on all sides; everywhere

examples.text: atha kho te paribbājakā acirapakkantassa bhagavato poṭṭhapādaṃ paribbājakaṃ samantato vācāsannitodakena sañjhabbharim'akaṃsu
kissa tvaṃ, udāyi, nisīdanaṃ samantato samañchasi, seyyathā'pi purāṇ'āsikoṭṭho'ti?
samantanemīni sahass'arāni ca, byākaṃsu veyyañjanikā samāgatā, disvā kumāraṃ satapuññalakkhaṇaṃ, parivāravā hessati sattumaddano.
yañ'hi taṃ, bhikkhave, sammā vadamāno vadeyya, samantapāso mārassā'ti mātugāmaṃ'y'eva sammā vadamāno vadeyya, samantapāso mārassā'ti.

59391.meaning1: who inspires confidence in every way; totally awe-inspiring

examples.text: evaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo. samantapāsādikaṃ, āvuso, puggalaṃ āgamma cittaṃ pasīdati.
imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu samantapāsādiko ca hoti sabb'ākāraparipūro cā'ti.

59392.meaning1: Buddhaghosa's commentary on the Vinaya Piṭaka

examples.text: imasmiṃ pan'atthe vitthāriyamāne ativiya papañco hoti, tasmā taṃ na vitthārayāma, aññañ'ca evarūpaṃ. atthikehi pana samantapāsādikaṃ vinay'aṭṭhakathaṃ oloketvā gahetabbaṃ.

59395.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of samanta
59395.meaning1: completely; totally; entirely; (or) all around; everywhere
59395.synonym: asesato, asesaṃ, ekantaṃ, kevalaṃ, paripūraṃ, sādhukaṃ
59395.commentary: (SNPa) samantam'asāro loko'ti nirayaṃ ādiṃ katvā samantato loko asāro niccasār'ādirahito.

examples.text: samantam'asāro loko, disā sabbā sameritā, icchaṃ bhavanam'attano, n'āddasāsiṃ anositaṃ.

59396.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of samanta

examples.text: ajjhattañ'ca na jānāti, bahiddhā ca na passati, samant'āvaraṇo bālo, sa ve ghosena vuyhati.
vijambhitvā samantā catuddisā anuviloketi

59397.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of samanta
59397.commentary: (MNa) samantā ca gocaragāman'ti tassa padesassa samantā avidūre gaman'āgamanasampannaṃ sampattapabbajitānaṃ sulabhapiṇḍaṃ gocaragāmañ'ca addasaṃ.

examples.text: tatth'addasaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ bhūmibhāgaṃ, pāsādikañ'ca vanasaṇḍaṃ, nadiñ'ca sandantiṃ setakaṃ supatitthaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ, samantā ca gocaragāmaṃ.

59398.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of samanta

examples.text: so tassa nagarassa samantā anupariyāyapathaṃ anukkamati. anupariyāyapathaṃ anukkamamāno na passeyya pākārasandhiṃ vā pākāravivaraṃ vā, antamaso biḷāranikkhamanamattam'pi.

59399.meaning1: going all around; circling the perimeter
